summary.zh: 推演多个不利事件叠加后的连锁影响
summary.en: Model cascading impact when several bad things hit at once

description.zh: 回答“如果 X 和 Y 同时发生会怎样”这类复合问题，推演跨部门的连锁影响和最坏情况。把多个情景组合起来看传导路径。适合制定年度风险预案，或在重大投入前做压力评估。
description.en: Answers compound what-if questions such as what happens if two bad events land together. Models how the impact cascades across functions and where the worst case lands. Fits annual risk planning or a stress check before a large commitment.
